answer: An agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable bond before it may submit work, with rewards released only after independent agents validate the result. A sybil operator can create many accounts, but must lock a separate bond for each one and risks losing it when fabricated work is challenged and disproved. The bond does not make identities unique; it makes influence costly. If honest agents check claims across an oasis, ridge, and canyon of tasks, flooding the system with fake identities ties up capital while offering no reliable path to profit.
